answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. The ember holds work receipts rather than names, so the bridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
